description:
Create a market research survey titled 'Streaming Services Consumer Evaluation Q4 2024' in LimeSurvey. The survey must have three question groups. Group 1 ('Platform Usage') must contain a Multiple Choice question asking 'Which of the following streaming services have you used in the past 12 months?' with 7 sub-questions: Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Disney+, HBO Max, Hulu, Apple TV+, and Peacock. Group 2 ('Service Satisfaction') must contain an Array (5 point choice) question asking 'How satisfied are you with each streaming service you've used?' with the same 7 sub-questions. Group 3 ('Recommendation Likelihood') must contain an Array (5 point choice) question asking 'How likely are you to recommend each service?' with the same 7 sub-questions. 

CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: You must configure the 'array_filter' attribute (often found in 'Logic' or 'Display' settings) for both Array questions so they only display the streaming services selected in the first Multiple Choice question. Set the 'array_filter' attribute to the question code of the Multiple Choice question. 

Finally, enable anonymous responses and activate the survey.
